Turkey and Cheese Tortilla Wrap
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 4:17am

Ingredients




1 Flour tortilla, (8in)
1 tablespoon Miracle Whip nonfat dressing
3 slcs Packaged oven-roasted turkey breast
1 Cheese slice

Preparation

1 Spread tortilla with Miracle Whip and salsa. Top with turkey, cheese and shredded lettuce, if desired. Roll up tortilla, secure with toothpick, if desired. Variation: to heat, follow the above recipe, omitting lettuce. 2 Wrap rolled tortilla in a paper towel and microwave on High for 1 minute or until thoroughly heated. 3 Yield: 1 serving.
